name: Purshottam Investofin Limited
summary: Purshottam Investofin Limited, a non-banking financial company, engaged in the business of financing and dealing in securities market. It also engages in trading of securities; lending business; and provides loans and advances in India. It is also involved in investment in shares, securities, and other related activities. Purshottam Investofin Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in New Delhi, India.
